title: Leftover bank — distractor items that match no zone
description: Verifies that DragMatch handles distractor items: items in the bank that no zone accepts. The widget should grade as correct as long as every zone's accepts set is satisfied — leftover bank items are fine.

data.markdown: Sometimes you want to test discrimination: "these belong, those don't". DragMatch supports this by simply listing extra items in `items` that no zone's `accepts` references. The grader (in `validateDragMatch`) only checks per-zone correctness; items left in the bank are not penalised.

sections.title: Sort the real Python stdlib modules from the impostors

data.prompt: Drag the names that are real Python standard-library modules into the "Real stdlib" zone. Leave the impostors in the bank.
data.explanation: `itertools`, `collections`, `pathlib`, and `functools` ship with CPython. `tablesort`, `asyncreq`, and `jsonfast` are made-up names and should be left in the bank as distractors.
